pages.text: <name> tiptoed into the kitchen, eyes gleaming. On the counter sat the last samosa from last night’s snack tray. 'This one is mine,' he whispered, licking his lips.
He reached out, but poof! The samosa seemed to shift slightly. 'Huh? Did it move?' <name> blinked. He leaned closer — and the samosa was gone!
Impossible, he muttered. He looked around. The cat, Puchi, sat innocently near the window, tail flicking. 'Was that you?' <name> asked. Puchi blinked slowly, like cats do, and trotted away.

<name> checked all hiding spots — under the toaster, behind jars, inside the cookie tin. No samosa. 'Maybe my little sister is behind this!' he thought. He peeked into the bedroom: Riya was quietly giggling, but shook her head. 'Not me!'

<name> set a clever trap. He placed a tiny piece of paper with a note: 'I’m watching you, samosa!' and hid behind the fridge. Within minutes, the samosa had disappeared again! It had rolled under the sofa. He crawled on the floor, sliding like a cartoon hero.

The chase continued. Samosa rolled past the cat, bounced off a chair, and Puchi leaped to intercept — only to knock over a stack of plates, clattering loudly. <name> ducked and lunged, grabbing the samosa just before it could roll away again.

Panting and laughing, <name> held the golden, crispy prize high. 'Finally!' he cheered. Just then, Riya peeked in. 'Sharing makes it more fun, you know.' <name> grinned and broke the samosa into pieces, giving one to Puchi, one to Riya, and one to Mom and Dad.

Everyone laughed as they munched. Even the cat purred happily, licking crumbs off the counter. <name> realized that the funniest part wasn’t the samosa itself, but the wild chase, the blaming, and the silly pranks that made the snack extra special.
That evening, the family teased him about the 'Great Samosa Hunt,' and <name> promised: next time, he’d hide the samosa better, but maybe leave a few crumbs for the cat.
Everyone went to bed laughing, dreaming of crispy samosas, playful cats, and mischievous little siblings. <name> couldn’t wait for the next adventure in the kitchen!
